versions.content: Dem can directly access dataElement s in PPortProto- type s typed by a SenderReceiverInterface An exception to the rule described in [constr_2019] applies: the Dem can directly access dataElement s in Abstract- ProvidedPortPrototype s typed by a SenderReceiverInterface . For this purpose, the ServiceSwComponentType that represents the Dem function- ality can have RPortPrototype s typed by a compatible SenderReceiverInter- face that may set isService to FALSE .

For this purpose, the ServiceSwComponentType that represents the Dem function- ality can have RPortPrototype s typed by a compatible SenderReceiverInter- face that may set isService to FALSE .

Dem can directly access SenderReceiverInterface . dataElement s, NvDataInterface . nvData s, or ParameterInterface . param- eter s in PPortPrototype s An exception to the rule described in [constr_2019] applies: the Dem can directly access SenderReceiverInterface . dataEle- ment s, NvDataInterface . nvData s, or ParameterInterface . parameter s in AbstractProvidedPortPrototype s ( PPortPrototype in case of Parameter- Interface . parameter ) as long as [constr_1071] is fulfilled. For this purpose, the ServiceSwComponentType that represents the Dem function- ality can have RPortPrototype s typed by a compatible SenderReceiverInter- face that may set attribute isService to false .
